title: Aun cuando cueste la vida: concesión hipotética extrema
goal: Deploy 'aun cuando', 'aun a riesgo de que', and 'así' with the subjunctive to construct high-stakes ethical and argumentative commitments.
grammar: Concesión hipotética extrema con aun cuando

sections.title: Unit 8: Concession & Counter-Argument — Lesson 4
body: Welcome to lesson 4 of Unit 8 (Concession & Counter-Argument). Mastering concessive nuances is fundamental for advanced debate, academic writing, and diplomatic discourse in Spanish.
In this lesson, we examine aun cuando cueste la vida: concesión hipotética extrema, calibrating indicative vs. subjunctive triggers to construct persuasive counter-arguments.

items: Deploy 'aun cuando', 'aun a riesgo de que', and 'así' with the subjunctive to construct high-stakes ethical and argumentative commitments.
Incorporate upper-intermediate debate lexicon (la lealtad, honesto).
